FORGE FINALE -- session 4: shipped a real fix (WARRANT#219, build SLS154)

Found the volatility-scoring bug from last update actually existed at 7 places in the file, not 2 -- including the one that matters most: the actual search engine the ~90min calibration run optimizes against. Fixed all 7 with one shared formula (copied from the real live scorer, so they can't drift apart again), compiled clean (0 errors/0 warnings), deployed to all 3 locations, verified byte-identical. Did NOT touch anything live -- terminal isn't running, this takes effect on the next restart same as everything else today.

Score still 11/45 (bug fixes don't flip a criterion until the whole component family is done -- 3 more components have gaps, one needs your call on which of 3 competing formulas is "right" before I touch it).

Loop still running, checking in fast per your last instruction.
